title: StarRocks cluster bring-up + cold-rebuild (the demo verb showcase)
description: The cluster-level demo: from-zero bring-up of the 6-node StarRocks cluster + the cold-rebuild gate. Builds AFTER 0.G.5 (ClickHouse) is sealed + its VMs stopped. Cross-env order: foundation -> security -> packer build x2 -> analytics-starrocks apply -> smoke.

steps.command: cd nexus-infra-vmware && pwsh -File scripts/foundation.ps1 apply && pwsh -File scripts/security.ps1 apply

observe.what: foundation writes the 6 StarRocks dhcp-host reservations + the starrocks-fe.nexus.lab round-robin + extends the NFS export to the BE; security writes the starrocks-server PKI role + 6 AppRole sidecars + root/app KV seeds

steps.command: cd nexus-infra-analytics && (cd packer/analytics-starrocks-fe-node && packer init . && packer build .) && (cd packer/analytics-starrocks-be-node && packer init . && packer build .)

observe.what: two .vmx templates built (JDK + StarRocks FE / BE from the release tarball, nexus-* units DISABLED)

6 clones -> firstboot -> nftables -> vault-agents -> tls -> fe-bootstrap (leader + 2 followers; BDB-JE quorum) -> be-join (ALTER SYSTEM ADD BACKEND x3) -> schema-bootstrap (DISTRIBUTED BY HASH BUCKETS + replication_num=3 + RBAC) -> backup-repo (NFS + repository)
every section GREEN: identity, vault-agent, mTLS, FE quorum (1 leader + 2 followers), 3 BE alive, tablets across 3 BE + replication_num=3, RBAC, round-robin DNS, backup mount

whatProves: the 6-node StarRocks cluster builds from absolute zero and is genuinely sharded (tablets across 3 BE) AND replicated (replication_num=3) with a fault-tolerant FE BDB-JE quorum, mTLS, and backup-capability. The cold-rebuild gate is the phase-0.G.6 exit criterion + the v0.1.0 tag trigger for nexus-infra-analytics.
